name: install-july-harness

deps: bash -c 'VENV_DIR="$HOME/venv"; [ -d "$VENV_DIR/bin" ] || { echo "Missing $VENV_DIR"; exit 1; }; if [ ! -x "$VENV_DIR/bin/gemini" ]; then mkdir -p "$VENV_DIR/gemini-cli" && npm install --no-audit --no-fund --prefix "$VENV_DIR/gemini-cli" @google/gemini-cli && ln -sf ../gemini-cli/node_modules/.bin/gemini "$VENV_DIR/bin/gemini"; fi'

build: bash -c 'source "$HOME/venv/bin/activate" && echo "venv python: $(which python3)" && echo "gemini bin:  $(which gemini)" && echo "gemini ver:  $(gemini --version)" && echo "harness bin: $(which july-harness)"'
